definitions.explanation: An organized event where products, artworks, or other items are displayed for viewing by the public or by industry professionals.

examples.japanese: {展示会|てんじかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{展示会|てんじかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: Next week, an automobile exhibition will be held in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{展示会|てんじかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出展|しゅってん}→出展：11986_shutten⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many companies from around the world exhibit at this trade show every year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧ (display/exhibition) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (event/meeting). Refers to organized events where products, artworks, technology, etc. are put on display. Can range from art shows to large-scale trade fairs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展示会|てんじかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold an exhibition
- {展示会|てんじかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出展|しゅってん}→出展：11986_shutten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exhibit at a trade show
- {展示会|てんじかい}⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: exhibition venue
- ⟦{合同|ごうどう}→合同：04185_goudou⟧{展示会|てんじかい}: joint exhibition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧: exhibition — primarily for art and cultural works
- ⟦{博覧会|はくらんかい}→博覧会：29493_hakurankai⟧: exposition/fair — larger scale, often international
- ⟦{見本市|みほんいち}→見本市：14339_mihonichi⟧: trade fair — specifically for commercial/industry displays
